execution.outerWrapperFault: The outer process wrapper opened the lease-declared stdout and stderr paths before spawning the frozen transport. The frozen transport correctly requires stdout, stderr, receipt and receipt.pending to be absent before it may invoke SSH.

successorExecutionBoundary.outerCapture: Capture the process exit code outside the literal argv without shell redirection, file precreation or any operation on the lease-declared stdout, stderr, receipt or receipt.pending paths.
successorExecutionBoundary.transport: Invoke the Central-signed literal argv directly once; the frozen transport exclusively owns the declared output and receipt paths.

requiredCentralAction: Atomically release P0-288 as consumed/nonreusable with Heavy=null. Do not infer any remote state from this local pre-SSH fail-closed terminal.
